title: Transaction outcome when a reactive subscriber cancels
summary: The pinned reactive operator rolled back cancellation at the merge. Moving take(1) inside its transaction preserved the row.

change.description: Spring changes the cleanup for a cancellation observed by a reactive transaction from commit to rollback. It applies to TransactionalOperator and annotated reactive method interception. The Kotlin executeAndAwait extension also waits for completion.

notes: The exact TransactionalOperatorImpl.java from each pin is compiled against the same Spring 5.3.0-M1 transaction and R2DBC companions. A delegating manager waits for real H2 transaction cleanup before a fresh unpooled read. These results cover the Java operator.
